source.name: USGS National Hydrography Dataset — High Resolution

note: Approximate river course for orientation, not a recommended navigation channel. Landing connections, bridge passages and alternative side channels are not mapped. Does not enable GPS time remaining or change the independently sourced planning mileage.

overviewReview.routeReview: Reviewed river-course overview. Exact landing connections, safe bridge passages and alternate side channels are not mapped.
overviewReview.note: For orientation only. Landing connections and safe bridge passages are not mapped; channels and conditions may differ.

acceptedIssues.mileage-difference-over-5-percent: Source-course length differs from nearby FWP river-mile markers. Both are approximate; the dotted line does not replace the independently sourced planning distance.

putIn.note: Course ends near the approximate access area; no exact ramp connection is implied.

takeOut.note: Course ends near the approximate access area; no exact ramp connection is implied.

review.note: Explicit branch decisions and full-course imagery review preserve a continuous downstream source course. Combined trips reuse those same edges without straight connectors. Exact landing connections and navigation through side channels are not established.
